meta.description: Format MediaWiki wikitext in your browser. Templates, tables, lists and links are tidied only when the formatter can show the page still means the same thing, and your text never leaves your device.
meta.og-description: Tidy MediaWiki wikitext safely, right in your browser.

status.ready.detail: Press Format or {shortcut} to tidy the source.
status.changed.detail: {count, plural, one {# line changed} other {# lines changed}} in {duration}.
status.unchanged.detail: The source already follows these rules. Checked in {duration}.
status.outdated.source: You edited the source after this result was made. Format again to update it.
status.outdated.options: Settings changed after this result was made. Format again to apply them.
status.outdated.both: The source and settings changed after this result was made. Format again to update it.
status.applied.detail: The result is now your source. Press {shortcut} in the source to undo.
status.formatting-stopped: Formatting stopped. The formatter restarted and is ready again.
status.result-discarded: The source or settings changed while formatting, so that result was set aside. Format again for a fresh one.
failure.input-parse: The parser couldn't read this text, or it nests more than 500 levels deep.
failure.input-roundtrip: This text can't be read and written back byte for byte, so it can't be formatted safely.
failure.unsupported-parser-config: This parser configuration isn't available in the browser.
failure.unsupported-line-endings: The text mixes Windows (CRLF) and Unix (LF) line endings, or has stray CR characters. Convert it to one style and format again.
failure.output-parse: The formatted text didn't read back cleanly, so it was discarded.
failure.template-equivalence: Formatting would have changed how a template is called, so the result was discarded.
failure.table-equivalence: Formatting would have changed a table's structure, so the result was discarded.
failure.document-equivalence: Formatting would have changed the page's structure, so the result was discarded.
failure.idempotency: Formatting the result a second time changed it again, so neither version was used.
failure.template-convergence: Templates didn't settle into a stable layout within the pass limit.
failure.table-convergence: Tables didn't settle into a stable layout within the pass limit.
failure.formatter-exception: The formatter hit an internal error.
error.client-disposed: The formatter has shut down. Reload the page to start it again.
error.request-rejected: The formatter turned down this request. Try formatting again.
error.unknown: The formatter stopped unexpectedly. Format again, or reload the page if it keeps happening.
error.worker-initialization-failed: The formatter couldn't start in this browser. Reload the page to try again.
error.worker-invalid-generation: The formatter answered an older request. Reload the page to restart it.
error.worker-invalid-response: The formatter sent back something this page couldn't read. Reload the page to restart it.
error.worker-not-ready: The formatter is still starting. Try again in a moment.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Choose which rules run and how they lay out your wikitext. Changes apply the next time you format.
settings.preset.default.hint: Tidies templates, tables, headings, lists, links and the page footer.
settings.preset.production.hint: Everything in Default, plus references, external links, spacing around headings, and interlanguage links moved to the footer.
settings.format-templates.hint: Lay out template calls and turn underscores in template names into spaces.
settings.line-width.hint: A template call on its own line stays on one line if it fits in this many characters. Otherwise it gets one parameter per line.
settings.inline-spacing.hint: Auto picks whichever spacing fits within the line width.
settings.format-tables.hint: Tidy table, row and cell markup.
settings.cell-separator.hint: Keep as written only fixes spacing. Auto and One per line put each cell on its own line.
settings.headings.hint: Put one space inside the == markers.
settings.lists.hint: Put one space after list markers such as * and #.
settings.section-spacing.hint: Add a blank line between a heading and the content next to it.
settings.normalize-blank-lines.hint: Reduce three or more blank lines in a row to two.
settings.html-void-tags.hint:
How to write
,
and when they have no attributes.
settings.wikilinks.hint: Replace underscores with spaces in link targets.
settings.external-links.hint: Fix spacing in labelled external links that sit on their own line.
settings.file-links.hint: Tidy file and image links that sit on their own line.
settings.redirects.hint: Tidy a #REDIRECT on the first line.
settings.categories.hint: Tidy category and DEFAULTSORT lines in the footer.
settings.behavior-switches.hint: Tidy magic words such as __NOTOC__ on their own line.
settings.interlanguage-prefixes.hint: Separate with commas. Only links with these prefixes count as interlanguage links.
settings.wrap-lines.hint: Only affects the display. Your text is not changed.
settings.level.hint: Rules above this class never run. Safe only allows just headings, blank lines and break tags.
settings.reset-all.title: Also resets theme, language and line wrapping
